subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors. 1  5 =
stimulus: Man is the architect of his own fortune. (a) ⎯⎯ he makes proper division of his time (b) ⎯⎯ does his duties accordingly, he is sure to prosper in life. (c) ⎯⎯ he does otherwise, he is sure to repent (d) ⎯⎯ it is too late. To kill time is (c) ⎯⎯ culpable as to commit suicide.
guide_solution: Use of sentence connectors (a) If (b) and (c) If (d) when (e) as
source: SSC English 2nd-paper Rajuk Uttara Model School & College, Dhaka (Test Paper School 2nd) 2023
